Plan review PASS (0 blocking) at head_sha e278425d7a, attestation signed; claimed.

Advisory noted for the commit message (G1G2, priority 0.31, deferred): the moving half is **23** `resolve_*` entry points plus `repo_root_or_none` = 24 public entry points, not '24 resolve_*'. Total moved names = 24 entry points + 4 private helpers (`_positive_int`, `_snapshot_table`, `_snapshot_int`, `_gate_str_pref`) + the constant `_DEFAULT_ABSENT_RETIRE_GRACE` = 29. The 29 tally in the plan was already correct; only the label was loose. The commit message will use the corrected phrasing. Not re-editing the description, since post-review prose edits invalidate the attestation.

Two-sided binding check (recorded before any edit):
- SIDE 1 (symbols MOVED): a per-name quoted-string grep across tests/, scripts/, src/, docs/ for all 29 moved names returned ZERO hits. Nothing monkeypatches, getattrs, or importlib-resolves any moved symbol by name.
- SIDE 2 (symbols the moved code CALLS): exactly one moved body reaches back into the staying half — `_snapshot_table` (src/rebar/_config_sources.py:440-458) uses `user_config_path`, `_read_toml_table`, `_discover_project_config`. Live patches on those exist (tests/unit/test_config_perf.py:60-66 patches `rebar.config._discover_project_config`), and tests/unit/test_plan_review.py:507 patches `rebar.config.repo_root` — the exact Gerrit-1932 class. Remedy applied: `_snapshot_table` resolves all three through a lazy in-body `from rebar import _config_sources` and calls them as module attributes at call time, so the lookup hits the same `_config_sources.__dict__` slot as today. `repo_root` itself is only reached transitively via `_discover_project_config`, which does not move, so its binding is untouched.
